m1.test_statistic: arithmetic mean of case-level paired differences d_i = M1_FAR,i - M1_baseline,i
m1.null_randomization: paired sign flip; zero differences fixed at zero
m1.exact_p_value: extreme_sign_assignments / all_sign_assignments, with extreme defined by absolute statistic >= absolute observed statistic
m1.monte_carlo_sign_rule: for draw r >= 1 and case_id, sign is +1 when the low-order bit of SHA256(UTF8('20260922|M1|' + baseline + '|' + decimal(r) + '|' + case_id)) is 0, otherwise -1; multiply only nonzero d_i
m1.extreme_rule: absolute permuted statistic >= absolute observed statistic
m1.direction_requirement_for_survival: observed mean paired difference < 0 for every baseline
m1.effect_estimator: paired Hodges-Lehmann one-sample location estimator: median of all Walsh averages (d_i + d_j) / 2 for i <= j over the complete paired cases; for an even number of Walsh averages, median is the arithmetic mean of the two central sorted values

m2.bootstrap_statistic: arithmetic mean of the resampled case-level paired M2 differences
m2.bootstrap_index_rule: for draw r >= 1 and position p from 1..n, index = integer(SHA256(UTF8('20260922|M2|' + baseline + '|' + decimal(r) + '|' + decimal(p))), 16) mod n; use the complete-pair case list sorted by case_id
m2.quantile_rule: sort the 10000 bootstrap statistics ascending; one-sided 95% lower bound uses zero-based index ceil(0.05*N)-1 = 499; ordinary one-sided 95% upper descriptive bound uses ceil(0.95*N)-1 = 9499; Bonferroni familywise directional-falsification upper bound uses ceil((1-0.05/3)*N)-1 = 9833; N=10000
m2.survival_multiplicity: intersection-union gate: every baseline lower 95% bound must exceed -0.05; no additional multiplicity correction is required for the global pass gate
m2.design_threshold_note: The absolute 0.05 margin/effect threshold is preregistered for this benchmark and is not asserted to be an externally validated practical-utility threshold.

missingness.at_or_below_threshold: complete-pair confirmatory analysis plus frozen best/worst-case sensitivity analysis
missingness.m1_worst_case_for_far: for each nonratable case set FAR=1 and baseline=0
missingness.m1_best_case_for_far: for each nonratable case set FAR=0 and baseline=1
missingness.m2_worst_case_for_far: for each nonratable case set FAR=0 and baseline=1
missingness.m2_best_case_for_far: for each nonratable case set FAR=1 and baseline=0
missingness.survival_robustness_rule: SURVIVES requires the complete-pair gates to pass and the worst-case-for-FAR imputation to preserve every M1 and M2 primary gate; if complete-pair gates pass but worst-case sensitivity reverses any gate, status is INDETERMINATE
missingness.ceiling_hit_rule: reaching a frozen resource ceiling is an observed run outcome and is not an exclusion; only exogenous infrastructure/configuration failure may make the entire four-condition case nonratable

falsification.m1: against at least one baseline: observed mean paired difference > 0, Hodges-Lehmann estimate >= +0.05, and corresponding Holm-adjusted two-sided M1 permutation result significant at family-wise alpha 0.05
falsification.m2: against at least one baseline: Bonferroni familywise one-sided upper bootstrap bound at confidence 1-0.05/3 for FAR minus baseline < -0.05

authority: Numerical and algorithmic analysis parameters copied into the preregistration and hardening amendment; changing any value or rule requires a new benchmark version before execution.
